title: 0082 고객 초대 링크 · 고객의 설치 날 변경 요청 · A/S 를 만든 팩토리가 받는다 — 초대는 서버만(토큰 해시 · 한 번 · 같은 업체만), 요청 칸은 구성원이 읽기만, A/S 처리 업체 칸 · 읽기 정책 · 알림 종류
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'manager', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, 'partner', 'probe Y', 'expert', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, {{y_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.customers (id, company_id, name) VALUES ({{customer_x}}, {{company_x}}, 'probe'), ({{customer_y}}, {{company_y}}, 'probe')
INSERT INTO public.projects (id, company_id, customer_id, title) VALUES ({{project_x}}, {{company_x}}, {{customer_x}}, 'probe X'), ({{project_y}}, {{company_y}}, {{customer_y}}, 'probe Y')

INSERT INTO public.customer_invites (id, company_id, customer_id, project_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_by) VALUES ({{invite_x}}, {{company_x}}, {{customer_x}}, {{project_x}}, repeat('a', 64), now() + interval '7 days', {{x_owner_user}})

INSERT INTO public.customer_invites (id, company_id, customer_id, project_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES ({{invite_used}}, {{company_x}}, {{customer_x}}, {{project_x}}, repeat('b', 64), now() + interval '7 days')
UPDATE public.customer_invites SET used_at = now(), used_by = {{y_owner_user}} WHERE id = {{invite_used}}
INSERT INTO public.designs (id, user_id, name, company_id) VALUES ({{design_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'probe', {{company_x}})
INSERT INTO public.design_schedules (id, design_id, batch_id, type, title, scheduled_at) VALUES ({{sched_x}}, {{design_x}}, gen_random_uuid(), 'installation', '설치', timestamptz '2026-12-03 09:00+09')
UPDATE public.design_schedules SET customer_change_requested_at = now(), customer_change_by = {{y_owner_user}}, customer_change_note = '오후로 바꿔 주세요' WHERE id = {{sched_x}}

checks.name: 초대 읽기 — 서버만 (구성원 · 익명 deny)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.customer_invites where project_id = {{project_x}}

checks.name: 쓴 초대 — 쓴 때와 사람이 적혔다 (준비 단계에서 썼다)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.customer_invites where id = {{invite_used}} and used_at is not null and used_by = {{y_owner_user}} and revoked_at is null

checks.name: 초대 만들기 — 서버가 한 줄 넣는다
checks.sql: insert into public.customer_invites (company_id, customer_id, project_id, token_hash, expires_at) values ({{company_x}}, {{customer_x}}, {{project_x}}, repeat('c', 64), now() + interval '3 days')

checks.name: 구성원은 초대를 직접 넣지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.customer_invites (company_id, customer_id, project_id, token_hash, expires_at) values ({{company_x}}, {{customer_x}}, {{project_x}}, repeat('d', 64), now() + interval '3 days')

checks.name: 같은 토큰은 하나
checks.sql: insert into public.customer_invites (company_id, customer_id, project_id, token_hash, expires_at) values ({{company_x}}, {{customer_x}}, {{project_x}}, repeat('a', 64), now() + interval '3 days')

checks.name: 토큰 해시가 너무 짧으면 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.customer_invites (company_id, customer_id, project_id, token_hash, expires_at) values ({{company_x}}, {{customer_x}}, {{project_x}}, 'short', now() + interval '3 days')

checks.name: 만료는 만든 때보다 뒤
checks.sql: insert into public.customer_invites (company_id, customer_id, project_id, token_hash, expires_at) values ({{company_x}}, {{customer_x}}, {{project_x}}, repeat('e', 64), now() - interval '1 day')

checks.name: 같은 업체 고객에게만 (남의 업체 고객 id 로는 거절)
checks.sql: insert into public.customer_invites (company_id, customer_id, project_id, token_hash, expires_at) values ({{company_x}}, {{customer_y}}, {{project_x}}, repeat('f', 64), now() + interval '3 days')

checks.name: 같은 업체 프로젝트에만
checks.sql: insert into public.customer_invites (company_id, customer_id, project_id, token_hash, expires_at) values ({{company_x}}, {{customer_x}}, {{project_y}}, repeat('g', 64), now() + interval '3 days')

checks.name: 쓴 사람만 있고 쓴 때가 없으면 거절
checks.sql: update public.customer_invites set used_by = {{x_owner_user}} where id = {{invite_x}}

checks.name: 쓴 초대는 거둘 수 없다
checks.sql: update public.customer_invites set revoked_at = now() where id = {{invite_used}}

checks.name: 초대 쓰기 — 서버가 쓴 때 · 사람을 적는다
checks.sql: update public.customer_invites set used_at = now(), used_by = {{y_owner_user}} where id = {{invite_x}}

checks.name: 설치 날 변경 요청 — 요청이 적혔다 (그 업체 구성원만 읽는다 · 남의 업체 0 · 익명 deny)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.design_schedules where id = {{sched_x}} and customer_change_requested_at is not null and customer_change_by = {{y_owner_user}}

checks.name: 구성원은 요청 칸을 직접 고치지 못한다 (쓰는 정책이 없다)
checks.sql: update public.design_schedules set customer_change_requested_at = null, customer_change_by = null, customer_change_note = null where id = {{sched_x}}

checks.name: 요청한 사람만 있고 때가 없으면 거절
checks.sql: update public.design_schedules set customer_change_requested_at = null where id = {{sched_x}}

checks.name: 바라는 것은 200자까지
checks.sql: update public.design_schedules set customer_change_note = repeat('가', 201) where id = {{sched_x}}

checks.name: 요청 지우기 — 서버가 셋 다 비운다
checks.sql: update public.design_schedules set customer_change_requested_at = null, customer_change_by = null, customer_change_note = null where id = {{sched_x}}

checks.name: A/S — 처리하는 업체 칸 둘이 있다
checks.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'as_requests' and column_name in ('handler_company_id', 'handler_project_id')

checks.name: A/S — 처리하는 업체는 수주 업체와 달라야 한다 (제약)
checks.sql: select count(*) from pg_constraint where conname = 'as_requests_handler_check' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%handler_company_id <> company_id%'

checks.name: A/S — 처리하는 팩토리 쪽 프로젝트는 그 팩토리 것만 (복합 FK)
checks.sql: select count(*) from pg_constraint where conname = 'as_requests_handler_project_fkey' and contype = 'f'

checks.name: A/S 지킴이 — 처리하는 업체도 바꾸지 못하게
checks.sql: select count(*) from pg_proc where proname = 'as_requests_guard' and prosrc like '%OLD.handler_company_id, OLD.handler_project_id%'

checks.name: A/S — 처리하는 팩토리 구성원 읽기 정책
checks.sql: select count(*) from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'as_requests' and policyname = 'as_requests_handler_read' and cmd = 'SELECT'

checks.name: 알림 종류 — as_factory · install_change 가 더해졌다 (옛 종류도 그대로)
checks.sql: select count(*) from pg_constraint where conname = 'notification_outbox_kind_check' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%as_factory%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%install_change%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%biz_cert_decided%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%''as_request''%'
